title: [MOSTLY PATCHED] Project Evolution V2 | Supports 5 games (check features)
features:
Note: This script has stopped being worked on by the developers, and the devs are currently making a V3. The V3 will have a key, but you can pay to get around that. This will not be edited for V3, but instead I will make another script for V3. You can go to https://www.projectevo.xyz/discord to know when V3 releases.

Disclaimer: The Jailbreak auto farm is pretty broken. Don't rely on it. It will probably be fixed in V3 though.
